request_body.title: Реки: продукт
request_body.description: Аудитория, stickiness, время игры, посты на игрока, распределения активности и темп прогресса; возврат D1/D7 и недельная неактивность. Публикации подтверждаются сервером. Время и новые возраста требуют релиза приложения.

panels.title: Аккаунтов сейчас в базе
panels.description: Прямой агрегат MongoDB, один профиль на Telegram-аккаунт. Счётчик собирается раз в минуту. Экран обновляется только при включённом автообновлении или нажатии «Обновить». Исторические ID ниже могут включать удалённые профили.

panels.title: Активных профилей сегодня · UTC
panels.description: Уникальные ID профилей с подтверждёнными событиями игры за текущую UTC-дату (03:00–03:00 МСК). Повторные входы одного профиля считаются один раз. Удаление и пересоздание даёт новый ID. Открытие только чата с ботом не является входом в игру. Включите автообновление 1m; при «Выкл» значение на экране устаревает.

queries.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT player_id) AS dau_today
FROM product
WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> ''
 AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time')
 AND _timestamp >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) * 86400000000
 AND _timestamp < (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) + 1) * 86400000000

panels.title: Исторические профили и stickiness
panels.description: Уникальные ID профилей в истории (90d), включая удалённые. Пересоздание профиля даёт новый ID; это не число людей. MAU30/WAU7; DAU UTC. Stickiness = DAU вчера / MAU за 30 полных дней до сегодня. История короче 30 дней → предварительная оценка.

queries.query:
SELECT 'Все игроки' AS segment, count(DISTINCT player_id) AS observed_profiles_90d,
 to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)) AS telemetry_since_utc,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 30 * 86400000000 THEN player_id END) AS mau_30d,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - 7 * 86400000000 THEN player_id END) AS wau_7d,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) THEN player_id END) AS dau_today,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 1 THEN player_id END) AS dau_yesterday,
 round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 1 THEN player_id END) /
 nullif(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 30) * 86400000000 AND _timestamp < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) * 86400000000 THEN player_id END), 0), 1) AS stickiness_yesterday_pct
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time')

panels.title: Возвращается ли аудитория: DAU
panels.description: Крайние дни диапазона неполные. Фоновые heartbeat и отправленные уведомления не считаются посещением.

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 day') AS day, count(DISTINCT player_id) AS dau
FROM "product" WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time')
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Сколько играют и публикуют: 7 полных дней
panels.description: Все/миры/возраст. Посты = серверный post_scored, не клики. Время — только active_time после нового релиза; NULL до измерений. Среднее/медиана минут на измеренный активный игроко-день, measured_player_days показывает покрытие.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (
 SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_scored' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'active_time' THEN try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS active_ms,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'level_up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_up,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'card_earned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_earned
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000)
 AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id, day
 HAVING max(CASE WHEN event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1),
 time_daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day, sum(try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS active_ms
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name = 'active_time' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) GROUP BY player_id, day),
 measured AS (SELECT d.player_id AS player_id, d.day AS day, d.posts AS posts, t.active_ms AS active_ms, d.level_up AS level_up, d.card_earned AS card_earned
 FROM daily d LEFT JOIN time_daily t ON d.player_id = t.player_id AND d.day = t.day)
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment, count(DISTINCT m.player_id) AS active_users,
 count(*) AS active_player_days, sum(m.posts) AS completed_posts,
 round(1.0 * sum(m.posts) / count(DISTINCT m.player_id), 2) AS posts_per_user_7d,
 round(1.0 * sum(m.posts) / count(*), 2) AS posts_per_active_day,
 count(m.active_ms) AS measured_player_days,
 round(avg(m.active_ms) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_active_minutes,
 round(approx_percentile_cont(m.active_ms, 0.5) / 60000.0, 2) AS median_active_minutes
FROM measured m JOIN segments s ON m.player_id = s.player_id GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment ORDER BY s.dimension, active_users DESC

panels.title: Интенсивность публикаций по мирам, %
panels.description: 100% = активные игроко-дни мира за 7 полных UTC-дней. Нулевые публикации включены. Сравнивать вместе с числом игроков в таблице выше.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (
 SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_scored' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'active_time' THEN try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS active_ms,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'level_up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_up,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'card_earned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_earned
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000)
 AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id, day
 HAVING max(CASE WHEN event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1),
 time_daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day, sum(try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS active_ms
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name = 'active_time' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) GROUP BY player_id, day),
 measured AS (SELECT d.player_id AS player_id, d.day AS day, d.posts AS posts, t.active_ms AS active_ms, d.level_up AS level_up, d.card_earned AS card_earned
 FROM daily d LEFT JOIN time_daily t ON d.player_id = t.player_id AND d.day = t.day), buckets AS (SELECT s.segment AS segment, CASE WHEN m.posts = 0 THEN '0 постов' WHEN m.posts = 1 THEN '1 пост' WHEN m.posts < 5 THEN '2–4 поста' WHEN m.posts < 10 THEN '5–9 постов' ELSE '10+ постов' END AS activity_bucket, count(*) AS player_days
 FROM measured m JOIN segments s ON m.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.dimension = 'world' GROUP BY s.segment, activity_bucket)
SELECT segment, activity_bucket, round(100.0 * player_days / sum(player_days) OVER (PARTITION BY segment), 1) AS player_days_pct
FROM buckets ORDER BY segment, activity_bucket

panels.title: Интенсивность публикаций по возрасту, %
panels.description: 100% = активные игроко-дни возрастного диапазона за 7 полных UTC-дней. 18+ (legacy) нельзя распределить задним числом.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (
 SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'post_scored' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts,
 sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'active_time' THEN try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS active_ms,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'level_up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_up,
 max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'card_earned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_earned
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000)
 AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id, day
 HAVING max(CASE WHEN event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1),
 time_daily AS (SELECT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day, sum(try_cast(prop_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS active_ms
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name = 'active_time' AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) GROUP BY player_id, day),
 measured AS (SELECT d.player_id AS player_id, d.day AS day, d.posts AS posts, t.active_ms AS active_ms, d.level_up AS level_up, d.card_earned AS card_earned
 FROM daily d LEFT JOIN time_daily t ON d.player_id = t.player_id AND d.day = t.day), buckets AS (SELECT s.segment AS segment, CASE WHEN m.posts = 0 THEN '0 постов' WHEN m.posts = 1 THEN '1 пост' WHEN m.posts < 5 THEN '2–4 поста' WHEN m.posts < 10 THEN '5–9 постов' ELSE '10+ постов' END AS activity_bucket, count(*) AS player_days
 FROM measured m JOIN segments s ON m.player_id = s.player_id WHERE s.dimension = 'age_group' GROUP BY s.segment, activity_bucket)
SELECT segment, activity_bucket, round(100.0 * player_days / sum(player_days) OVER (PARTITION BY segment), 1) AS player_days_pct
FROM buckets ORDER BY segment, activity_bucket

panels.title: Как часто возвращаются: DAU / MAU по сегментам
panels.description: Вчерашний DAU / MAU за 30 полных дней до сегодня. Не D1 retention. На короткой истории предварительно; знаменатель виден рядом.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 last_month AS (SELECT player_id, max(CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) = floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yesterday
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND _timestamp >= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 30) * 86400000000 AND _timestamp < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) * 86400000000
 AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id)
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment, count(*) AS mau_30d_yesterday,
 sum(m.yesterday) AS dau_yesterday, round(100.0 * sum(m.yesterday) / count(*), 1) AS stickiness_pct
FROM last_month m JOIN segments s ON m.player_id = s.player_id GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment ORDER BY s.dimension, s.segment

panels.title: Доходят ли до 1 / 3 / 10 публикаций, %
panels.description: Доля наблюдаемых игроков за 90d. Столбцы — отдельные пороги, не складываются. Когорты разного возраста: это охват прогресса, не причинное сравнение.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), scored AS (SELECT player_id, count(*) AS posts FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name = 'post_scored' GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players), totals AS (
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment, count(*) AS users,
 sum(CASE WHEN c.posts >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached_1,
 sum(CASE WHEN c.posts >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached_3,
 sum(CASE WHEN c.posts >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reached_10
FROM segments s LEFT JOIN scored c ON s.player_id = c.player_id GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment)
SELECT concat(dimension, ': ', segment) AS segment, '1 пост' AS milestone, round(100.0 * reached_1 / users, 1) AS users_pct FROM totals
UNION ALL SELECT concat(dimension, ': ', segment) AS segment, '3 поста' AS milestone, round(100.0 * reached_3 / users, 1) AS users_pct FROM totals
UNION ALL SELECT concat(dimension, ': ', segment) AS segment, '10 постов' AS milestone, round(100.0 * reached_10 / users, 1) AS users_pct FROM totals

panels.title: Темп игры: публикации и первые награды
panels.description: Медиана часов от первого наблюдения до третьего серверного поста только среди дошедших. Доли и база рядом; level_up = любой навык, card = любая награда. Не завершение всей игры.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id), scored AS (SELECT player_id, _timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY _timestamp) AS post_number FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name = 'post_scored'),
 milestones AS (SELECT player_id, min(CASE WHEN post_number = 1 THEN _timestamp END) AS first_post, min(CASE WHEN post_number = 3 THEN _timestamp END) AS third_post FROM scored GROUP BY player_id),
 awards AS (SELECT player_id, min(CASE WHEN event_name = 'level_up' THEN _timestamp END) AS first_level,
 min(CASE WHEN event_name = 'card_earned' THEN _timestamp END) AS first_card FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' GROUP BY player_id),
 segments AS (SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players)
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment, count(*) AS observed_users,
 count(m.first_post) AS first_post_users, round(100.0 * count(m.first_post) / count(*), 1) AS first_post_pct,
 count(m.third_post) AS third_post_users, round(100.0 * count(m.third_post) / count(*), 1) AS third_post_pct,
 round(approx_percentile_cont((m.third_post - p.first_seen) / 3600000000.0, 0.5), 2) AS median_hours_to_3_posts,
 count(a.first_level) AS level_up_users, round(100.0 * count(a.first_level) / count(*), 1) AS level_up_pct,
 count(a.first_card) AS card_users, round(100.0 * count(a.first_card) / count(*), 1) AS card_pct
FROM players p JOIN segments s ON p.player_id = s.player_id LEFT JOIN milestones m ON p.player_id = m.player_id LEFT JOIN awards a ON p.player_id = a.player_id
GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment ORDER BY s.dimension, s.segment

panels.title: Удержание когорт: D1 / D7
panels.description: Возврат в точный день после первого наблюдения. Незавершённые окна исключены; NULL — ещё рано измерять.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id),
 activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) AS day FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time')),
 watermark AS (SELECT floor(max(_timestamp) / 86400000000) AS day FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time'))
SELECT to_timestamp_micros(floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) * 86400000000) AS cohort_day,
 count(*) AS cohort_users,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_d1,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day AND a1.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_d1,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day AND a1.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
 nullif(sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS retention_d1_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_d7,
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day AND a7.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
 nullif(sum(CASE WHEN floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7 < w.day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS retention_d7_pct
FROM players p CROSS JOIN watermark w
LEFT JOIN activity a1 ON p.player_id = a1.player_id AND a1.day = floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 1
LEFT JOIN activity a7 ON p.player_id = a7.player_id AND a7.day = floor(p.first_seen / 86400000000) + 7
GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day

panels.title: Недельная неактивность: все и сегменты
panels.description: Активен в предыдущие 7 полных UTC-дней, отсутствует в последние 7. NULL до 14 дней истории / нулевой базы. Это не окончательный уход.

queries.query:
WITH players AS (SELECT player_id, min(_timestamp) AS first_seen,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(world, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-world' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(world, '')), 'unknown') END AS world,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END) > 1 THEN 'multi-age-group' ELSE coalesce(max(CASE WHEN age_group = '18+' THEN NULL ELSE nullif(age_group, '') END), CASE WHEN max(age_group) = '18+' THEN '18+ (legacy)' ELSE 'unknown' END) END AS age_group,
 CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT nullif(platform, '')) > 1 THEN 'multi-platform' ELSE coalesce(max(nullif(platform, '')), 'unknown') END AS platform
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id), segments AS (
 SELECT 'all' AS dimension, 'all' AS segment, player_id FROM players
 UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS dimension, world AS segment, player_id FROM players UNION ALL SELECT 'age_group' AS dimension, age_group AS segment, player_id FROM players),
 activity AS (SELECT player_id,
 max(CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS previous_week,
 max(CASE WHEN floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) >= floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 7 AND floor(_timestamp / 86400000000) < floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week
 FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time') GROUP BY player_id),
 coverage AS (SELECT min(_timestamp) AS first_event FROM product WHERE activity_kind = 'real' AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id <> '' AND event_name NOT IN ('notification_sent', 'active_time'))
SELECT s.dimension AS dimension, s.segment AS segment,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN sum(a.previous_week) END AS eligible_users,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN sum(CASE WHEN a.previous_week = 1 AND a.last_week = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS inactive_users,
 CASE WHEN min(c.first_event) <= (floor(date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 / 86400000000) - 14) * 86400000000 THEN
 round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN a.previous_week = 1 AND a.last_week = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(sum(a.previous_week), 0), 1) END AS weekly_churn_pct
FROM segments s JOIN activity a ON s.player_id = a.player_id CROSS JOIN coverage c
GROUP BY s.dimension, s.segment ORDER BY s.dimension, s.segment
